data.one_liner: A customizable, theme‑aware splash screen widget with timer or future navigation and entrance animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a full‑screen splash screen that can wait for a fixed duration or a Future before navigating to a destination. It supports Material 3 defaults, hero logo hand‑off, and several entrance animations.
use_when: You need a quick, theme‑consistent splash screen for a Flutter app
You want timer‑based or async‑based navigation after the splash
You want built‑in hero transitions and animation options
avoid_when: You require a native platform splash (iOS/Android launch screen)
You need a complex onboarding flow beyond a single splash
strengths: Flexible navigation via timer or Future
Built‑in entrance animations and hero support
data.minimal_example:
SplashScreen.timer(
  duration: Duration(seconds: 3),
  destination: SplashDestination.page(HomePage()),
  logo: FlutterLogo(),
  title: Text('Welcome'),
  message: Text('Loading…'),
);
